name: kivo-creator
description: Figma and HTML to WordPress on the Roots stack: ingest a design into neutral section specs, match each section to an existing block, scaffold only the gaps and prove fidelity with a pixel diff

interface.shortDescription: Figma and HTML to WordPress blocks on the Roots stack, reusing existing blocks first.
interface.longDescription: Ingests a Figma frame or an HTML page into neutral section specs, matches each section to a block the project already has, scaffolds only what is missing in the project's conventions and verifies the rendered page with a pixel diff, a style check and a lint for arbitrary values. Requires the kivo-wise plugin for stack detection.
